senses.gloss:
ठ 1. ठ, the twelfth consonant and aspi-
rate of the preceding letter.
—ठ-कार, अस्, m.
the letter or sound ठ्.
—ठकारय (fr. the last),
nom. P. ठकारयति: Desid. टिठकारयिषति.

ठ 2. ठ, अस्, m. a loud noise; an imitative
sound as of a golden pitcher rolling down steps; the
disk of the sun or moon, a circle, a globe; a cypher;
a place frequented or held sacred by all; an object of
sense; an idol, a deity; an epithet of Śiva.
